items.details: A straightforward first route is Chico before Paz. After opening his cage, carry him down toward the coastal pickup area and set him down when the objective requests it. Clear guards before lifting him again: carrying a passenger limits your ability to react. Use the iDroid to summon the helicopter to the chosen landing zone, then load Chico aboard. Do not board yourself while Paz still needs rescuing. Other captives can use the same pickup, but their rescue is optional.

details_i18n.en: A straightforward first route is Chico before Paz. After opening his cage, carry him down toward the coastal pickup area and set him down when the objective requests it. Clear guards before lifting him again: carrying a passenger limits your ability to react. Use the iDroid to summon the helicopter to the chosen landing zone, then load Chico aboard. Do not board yourself while Paz still needs rescuing. Other captives can use the same pickup, but their rescue is optional.
details_i18n.pt: Uma rota inicial simples é resgatar Chico antes de Paz. Depois de abrir a cela, carregue-o em direção ao embarque na costa e coloque-o no chão quando o objetivo pedir. Afaste os guardas antes de levantá-lo novamente: carregar um passageiro limita sua reação. Chame o helicóptero pelo iDroid ao ponto escolhido e embarque Chico. Não entre enquanto Paz ainda precisar de resgate. Os outros prisioneiros podem usar o mesmo embarque, mas seus resgates são opcionais.

items.details: Use Chico's recording and Miller's guidance to narrow the search to the administration building. A practical approach uses a side entrance into the compound, then the stairs leading to the basement boiler area. Watch the camera and guards around the access rather than running straight downstairs. After reaching Paz, check your escape route again before lifting her. The route used to enter is only a starting plan: patrol coverage can change during the rescue.

details_i18n.en: Use Chico's recording and Miller's guidance to narrow the search to the administration building. A practical approach uses a side entrance into the compound, then the stairs leading to the basement boiler area. Watch the camera and guards around the access rather than running straight downstairs. After reaching Paz, check your escape route again before lifting her. The route used to enter is only a starting plan: patrol coverage can change during the rescue.
details_i18n.pt: Use a gravação de Chico e as orientações de Miller para restringir a busca ao prédio administrativo. Uma aproximação prática usa uma entrada lateral do complexo e depois a escada até a área das caldeiras no subsolo. Observe a câmera e os guardas do acesso em vez de correr direto para a escada. Depois de encontrar Paz, examine novamente a fuga antes de levantá-la. A rota de entrada é apenas um plano inicial: as patrulhas podem mudar durante o resgate.

items.details: For Depth, both designated targets must survive and leave the mission with you. Use the target photographs and binoculars to avoid confusing them with escorts. Tranquilize or subdue each target, clear the surrounding guards and move the captive to an extraction route. Helicopter pickups are convenient; carrying a living target out in a vehicle also supports the capture objective. Do not replace a capture with a lethal shot just because the normal mission allows elimination. Verify both extractions before ending the operation.

details_i18n.en: For Depth, both designated targets must survive and leave the mission with you. Use the target photographs and binoculars to avoid confusing them with escorts. Tranquilize or subdue each target, clear the surrounding guards and move the captive to an extraction route. Helicopter pickups are convenient; carrying a living target out in a vehicle also supports the capture objective. Do not replace a capture with a lethal shot just because the normal mission allows elimination. Verify both extractions before ending the operation.
details_i18n.pt: Para Depth, os dois alvos designados precisam sobreviver e sair da missão com você. Use as fotos e os binóculos para não confundi-los com os acompanhantes. Tranquilize ou domine cada alvo, afaste os guardas próximos e leve o prisioneiro à rota de extração. O helicóptero é conveniente; sair de veículo com um alvo vivo também serve para a captura. Não substitua a captura por um disparo letal só porque a missão comum permite eliminar os alvos. Confirme as duas extrações antes de encerrar.

items.details: Use the nonlethal Uragan-5 revolver against human enemies throughout Intel Operative Rescue, including the crew of the hostile helicopter. Reload during travel gaps so the next attack does not catch you empty. The armored vehicle encounter can be resolved with the launcher without adding a personnel kill, but avoid blasting incapacitated soldiers nearby. The mission's scripted accidents differ from directly shooting an enemy with a lethal weapon. Check the final kill count rather than assuming every visible casualty invalidated the run.

details_i18n.en: Use the nonlethal Uragan-5 revolver against human enemies throughout Intel Operative Rescue, including the crew of the hostile helicopter. Reload during travel gaps so the next attack does not catch you empty. The armored vehicle encounter can be resolved with the launcher without adding a personnel kill, but avoid blasting incapacitated soldiers nearby. The mission's scripted accidents differ from directly shooting an enemy with a lethal weapon. Check the final kill count rather than assuming every visible casualty invalidated the run.
details_i18n.pt: Use o revólver não letal Uragan-5 contra os inimigos humanos em Intel Operative Rescue, inclusive a tripulação do helicóptero inimigo. Recarregue nos intervalos do deslocamento para não enfrentar o próximo ataque sem munição. O confronto com o veículo blindado pode ser resolvido com o lança-foguetes sem acrescentar uma morte de pessoal, mas evite atingir soldados incapacitados por perto. Os acidentes previstos pela missão diferem de atirar diretamente em alguém com arma letal. Confira o total final de mortes em vez de presumir que toda baixa visível invalidou a tentativa.

items.details: Remain in the starting truck until it reaches the administration area. Leave only when the surroundings are safe, recover the objective tape from the watchtower and return to the truck's cargo bed. Wait for the driver to resume his route and carry you outside the mission boundary. Calling the helicopter or leaving on foot finishes a different escape and will not satisfy Infiltration. Avoid provoking a search that prevents the driver from following his normal route.

details_i18n.en: Remain in the starting truck until it reaches the administration area. Leave only when the surroundings are safe, recover the objective tape from the watchtower and return to the truck's cargo bed. Wait for the driver to resume his route and carry you outside the mission boundary. Calling the helicopter or leaving on foot finishes a different escape and will not satisfy Infiltration. Avoid provoking a search that prevents the driver from following his normal route.
details_i18n.pt: Permaneça no caminhão inicial até ele chegar à área administrativa. Saia apenas quando os arredores estiverem seguros, recupere a fita do objetivo na torre de vigilância e volte à carroceria. Espere o motorista retomar a rota e levá-lo para fora do limite da missão. Chamar o helicóptero ou sair a pé conclui outra fuga e não cumpre Infiltration. Evite provocar uma busca que impeça o motorista de seguir o percurso normal.

items.details: Extraction requires four helicopter rescues in this Side Op: three captives in the eastern prison camp and one in the administration basement where Paz was held. Handle these before completing the demolition sequence, which adds pressure and a timed departure. Carry them to the coastal pickup and confirm every passenger has boarded. Vehicle escape alone does not replace the trophy's helicopter requirement. After the four rescues, return to the emplacements and finish the remaining mission objectives.

details_i18n.en: Extraction requires four helicopter rescues in this Side Op: three captives in the eastern prison camp and one in the administration basement where Paz was held. Handle these before completing the demolition sequence, which adds pressure and a timed departure. Carry them to the coastal pickup and confirm every passenger has boarded. Vehicle escape alone does not replace the trophy's helicopter requirement. After the four rescues, return to the emplacements and finish the remaining mission objectives.
details_i18n.pt: Extraction exige quatro resgates de helicóptero nesta Side Op: três prisioneiros nas celas do leste e um no subsolo administrativo onde Paz estava. Resolva isso antes de concluir a sequência de demolição, que aumenta a pressão e impõe uma saída com tempo limitado. Leve-os ao embarque na costa e confirme a entrada de cada passageiro. Fugir de veículo não substitui a exigência de helicóptero do troféu. Após os quatro resgates, volte às posições antiaéreas e conclua os objetivos restantes.

items.details: The seven photo objectives involve the surveillance camera, helicopter, searchlight item, Moai, blackout, jeep and armored vehicle. Match the photo's viewing position and wait for confirmation; simply looking at an object from afar may not count. Keep the camera, vehicle and other scene props intact until their scenes register. The generator switch and jeep route require interaction rather than observation alone. Recreate the full set before following the special exit route. The optional quiz is a separate follow-up challenge, not a substitute for any scene.

details_i18n.en: The seven photo objectives involve the surveillance camera, helicopter, searchlight item, Moai, blackout, jeep and armored vehicle. Match the photo's viewing position and wait for confirmation; simply looking at an object from afar may not count. Keep the camera, vehicle and other scene props intact until their scenes register. The generator switch and jeep route require interaction rather than observation alone. Recreate the full set before following the special exit route. The optional quiz is a separate follow-up challenge, not a substitute for any scene.
details_i18n.pt: Os sete objetivos das fotos envolvem a câmera de vigilância, o helicóptero, o item entre holofotes, o Moai, o apagão, o jipe e o blindado. Reproduza o ponto de vista da foto e espere a confirmação; apenas olhar de longe pode não contar. Preserve a câmera, o veículo e os demais elementos até registrar suas cenas. O interruptor do gerador e o trajeto de jipe exigem interação, não apenas observação. Recrie o conjunto completo antes de seguir a saída especial. O quiz opcional é um desafio posterior separado e não substitui nenhuma cena.

items.details: One of the nine patches is attached to Snake rather than lying at a normal search location. Find an open, safe patch of ground, go prone, aim and roll repeatedly until the short discovery sequence plays. Pick up the dislodged patch afterward; triggering the sequence alone does not replace collecting it. The other eight are ordinary pickups around Camp Omega during Ground Zeroes. Reach a checkpoint to preserve collection progress, then finish the main mission to receive the related unlocks.

details_i18n.en: One of the nine patches is attached to Snake rather than lying at a normal search location. Find an open, safe patch of ground, go prone, aim and roll repeatedly until the short discovery sequence plays. Pick up the dislodged patch afterward; triggering the sequence alone does not replace collecting it. The other eight are ordinary pickups around Camp Omega during Ground Zeroes. Reach a checkpoint to preserve collection progress, then finish the main mission to receive the related unlocks.
details_i18n.pt: Um dos nove emblemas está preso a Snake, em vez de estar em um ponto comum de busca. Encontre um trecho aberto e seguro, deite-se, mire e role repetidamente até ocorrer a breve cena de descoberta. Recolha o emblema solto em seguida; apenas acionar a cena não substitui a coleta. Os outros oito são itens comuns espalhados por Camp Omega durante Ground Zeroes. Alcance um checkpoint para preservar a coleta e termine a missão principal para receber os desbloqueios correspondentes.

items.details: Some main-mission recordings depend on rescue order, so use separate collection runs instead of forcing everything into your first clear. Chico's Tape 5 is available near the basement approach before rescuing Chico; returning afterward can miss its window. The escaped prisoner's rescue awards another recording, while other tapes are physical pickups in the camp. Check each named entry in your library and reach a checkpoint after pickups. Restart the mission when a timing-dependent tape is absent; the loss is recoverable.

details_i18n.pt: Algumas gravações da missão principal dependem da ordem dos resgates; use tentativas separadas em vez de tentar reunir tudo na primeira conclusão. items.details: Do this early in a dedicated Ground Zeroes run rather than after a long search. Beyond the initial perimeter, investigate the refugee camp with white tents on the western side; the escaped prisoner is inside a small wooden shelter. Neutralize immediate threats, carry him to a safe landing zone and put him aboard the helicopter. Finding or releasing him alone is insufficient: the special objective needs a successful extraction. Finish any other collection plans afterward.

details_i18n.en: Do this early in a dedicated Ground Zeroes run rather than after a long search. details_i18n.pt: Faça isso cedo em uma tentativa dedicada a Ground Zeroes, em vez de deixar para depois de uma longa busca. Após o perímetro inicial, investigue o acampamento de tendas brancas no lado oeste; o prisioneiro fugitivo está em um pequeno abrigo de madeira. Neutralize as ameaças imediatas, leve-o a um ponto seguro e embarque-o no helicóptero. Apenas encontrá-lo ou libertá-lo não basta: o objetivo especial exige uma extração concluída. items.details: For most original missions, clear Normal once, then complete its fastest-marking trial by identifying every enemy. Avoid killing an unmarked guard, which makes that trial impossible in the current attempt. Clear Hard to open its completion-time trial, then finish another Hard run to unlock the remaining entries. Intel Operative Rescue is the on-rails exception and does not use the normal binocular-marking routine. Check both difficulty lists for Ground Zeroes, four Side Ops and Déjà-Vu. Jamais Vu's additional records are optional for the original PS4 Unlocked trophy; online ranking is unnecessary. For S ranks, Normal is sufficient: reduce wasted time, avoid kills and disable Reflex for its score bonus.

details_i18n.en: For most original missions, clear Normal once, then complete its fastest-marking trial by identifying every enemy. Avoid killing an unmarked guard, which makes that trial impossible in the current attempt. Clear Hard to open its completion-time trial, then finish another Hard run to unlock the remaining entries. Intel Operative Rescue is the on-rails exception and does not use the normal binocular-marking routine. Check both difficulty lists for Ground Zeroes, four Side Ops and Déjà-Vu. Jamais Vu's additional records are optional for the original PS4 Unlocked trophy; online ranking is unnecessary. For S ranks, Normal is sufficient: reduce wasted time, avoid kills and disable Reflex for its score bonus.
details_i18n.pt: Na maioria das missões originais, conclua o Normal uma vez e depois cumpra o desafio de marcação rápida identificando todos os inimigos. Evite matar um guarda ainda não marcado, o que inviabiliza esse desafio na tentativa atual. Conclua o Difícil para abrir seu desafio de tempo e termine outra tentativa nessa dificuldade para liberar os registros restantes. Intel Operative Rescue é a exceção sobre trilhos e não usa a rotina comum de marcação por binóculos. Confira as duas dificuldades de Ground Zeroes, das quatro Side Ops e de Déjà-Vu. Os registros adicionais de Jamais Vu são opcionais para o troféu original Unlocked de PS4; rankings online são desnecessários. Para classificação S, o Normal basta: reduza o tempo perdido, evite mortes e desative Reflex para receber seu bônus de pontuação.
